faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Archived 1946 broadcast details homecoming soldiers consuming everything in existence.
kurzfassung: Guest host Leonard Burton presents an archived 1946 radio broadcast detailing the chaotic return of Night Vale's young soldiers from war. The veterans indulge in extreme celebrations, systematically destroying buildings, consuming crops, and eventually devouring the entire universe. After the tape concludes, Cecil abruptly returns to sign off the episode.
stichpunkte: Leonard Burton hosts a broadcast from the summer of 1946 focusing on soldiers returning home
The community calendar features bizarre local events including a breathing green tent
Returning veterans exhibit disturbing behaviors, climbing town hall and destroying local businesses
A commercial break features a heavy typewriter marketed as portable for outdoor use
A local farmer reports his fields ruined by soldiers who leave behind only imaginary corn
The celebrating veterans escalate their destruction, eventually consuming the town, earth, and stars
Cecil returns at the end of the episode just in time to sign off with holiday music announcements

clips.text: The temporary host reflects on the narrow vocabulary of past generations and tests his own existence by pausing mid-sentence.

clips.hook: I knifed a knave in Knoxville.
clips.text: The missing radio host struggles with audio transmission, accidentally broadcasting nonsensical phrases while trying to reach his audience.
